steps: Verify native source bytes and a causal accepted crop before contextual encoding. Use existing Packet/FrozenInput checks and keep role=development for these historical inputs.

Bind actual encoder identity, runtime and output dimensions. The existing audio output is 1536 real coordinates; text/video/image encoders remain unsupported until exact assets are registered. No truncation or padding into row55.
Represent every accepted observation as an event. Preserve source time and arrival time separately; retain equal timestamps and typed missing/error status.

Advance continuous state only for genuine elapsed duration using the previously accepted held input. Ingest a newly accepted event through a separately specified content/state update, even when elapsed duration is zero.
Use stable read_id/epoch and atomic content/receipt commit so an event is ingested at most once on replay. Reuse V14 late-result cancellation and exact acquired-content storage boundaries.
Keep the legacy row55 checkpoint replay as a separately named historical adapter. It cannot become new-A or strong-encoder evidence merely by changing the entry point.
Until event assimilation, output semantics and fixed addressor are frozen, the adapter may produce validated acquired-event records only. It must not emit a quality/adoption pass.
deterministic_acceptance_cases: Two distinct accepted events at identical physical time are both retained exactly once; no artificial dt is introduced
Future native samples and hidden labels cannot enter an encoder prefix or event features
Wrong source/encoder/dimension and unsupported modalities are rejected with explicit states
Retry/RESET preserves the registered content/clock semantics and rejects a cancelled late result
Every core receives identical accepted events, encoder outputs and addressor results under fixed-information replay

Define same-world factual queries, overwrites, aliases, missingness and citations. Old six-emotion probabilities are a different target.
